name: 52242 · Iowa City, IA
findings: ZIP 52242 (Iowa City) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52242 (Iowa City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
